title: No Intro Needed: 50 Rock Classics
description: 50 legendary rock tracks you absolutely know - but how fast can you name them? One thing's for sure: after the first riff, they'll be stuck in your head all night long!

title: Weekend Rock Anthems
description: Your weekend anthems and the biggest rock songs from the last 50 years! From the Beatles and the Stones in the 60s right through to One Republic and Kings Of Leon in the 10s.

title: The Wild Ones with Suzi Quatro!
description: Our godmother of Rock, Suzi Quatro is here with the wildest Rock Stars of the 70's! But who is the craziest and most outlandish? Bowie, Meatloaf, Queen or even Suzi herself?

title: Teenage Dirtbags! 1995-2010
description: From the rebellious teens of the 90's and 00's we bring you the stars who said To hell with the world and expressed themselves through great tunes!

title: All Killer: 00s Emo Anthems!
description: An hour of the greatest emo tracks the noughties had to offer featuring Linkin Park, Fall Out Boy, Thirty Seconds To Mars and My Chemical Romance.

title: Turn Up The 00s Anthems!
description: Turn up your spreakers to 11 and live life even louder! 50 All-Killer Anthems in order from Blink 182 in 2000 to The Killers at the end of the Decade!

title: Weekend Anthems!
description: Turn it up to 11 all weekend for the finest rock anthems! Featuring Kings Of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro & The Foo Fighters. This is Now Rock!

title: Alex Baker's 50 Rock Party Bangers
description: Alex Baker brings 50 of the best, most sing-alongable rock party bangers of all time, a treat for those who love Green Day, the Foo Fighters, Bon Jovi, and BMTH.

title: Essential Air Guitar: Killer Riffs
description: From killer riffs in the 20s right back to the legendary solos of the 80s, we're counting down 12 essential anthems that you just need to know!

title: Party Rock Anthems!
description: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss and Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore and The White Stripes.

title: 90s Rock Anthems!
description: Guitar epics and crossover rock anthems from the 90s, from Alannah Miles in 1990 to Aerosmith in 98.

title: The 90s: Guitars, Grunge & Glory!
description: Grunge happened, we kept the guitars! Britpop happened, we kept the Gallaghers! Nirvana brought angst, Blur brought swagger & everyone brought riffs, anthems & questionable hair!

title: 30 Big Selling Rock Songs of 90s!
description: Bruno Brookes with the biggest UK rock tracks of the 90s. Expect a decent slice of Stereophonics, Bon Jovi, Nirvana and RHCP. But you might be surprised at the No.1!

title: The 90s: Guitars, Grunge & Glory!
description: Grunge happened, we kept the guitars! Britpop happened, we kept the Gallaghers! Nirvana brought angst, Blur brought swagger & everyone brought riffs, anthems & questionable hair!

title: 101 Feel Good Rock Songs
description: 8 hours of the the biggest feel-good rock songs! With anthems from Status Quo to Queen, The Kaiser Chiefs to The Stones.

title: Big Hair & Power Chords!
description: 20 epic songs loaded with mega hair energy & power chords! From 80s rock icons Boston, Whitesnake & Chicago to modern day heroes The Darkness, Green Day & My Chemical Romance.

title: David Bowie: Rock Icon
description: Starting back in 1972, An hour of Anthems and the biggest rock songs from the king of glam rock David Bowie!

title: The Glam Squad with Claire Sturges
description: The most fabulous glam rock icons from the satin & glitter of 70s through to the bold new look of today. Glam Rock never left us, it just changed outfits!
